SELECT table_schema, table_name 
FROM information_schema.tables 
WHERE table_schema = 'production' 
AND (table_name ILIKE '%product%' AND table_name NOT ILIKE '%history%' AND table_name NOT ILIKE '%photo%' AND table_name NOT ILIKE '%document%' AND table_name NOT ILIKE '%model%')
ORDER BY table_name;
